question: At the Panorama International Literature Festival Awards, 2025, which young Indian received the Serena Memorial Child Prodigy Award, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nairithi Konduru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nairithi Konduru**, a young Indian talent, has been honored with the **Serena Memorial Child Prodigy Award 2025** at the **Panorama International Literature Festival (PILF)**.
 
• The award was conferred by the **Writers Capital International Foundation (WCIF)** during their global literary event held in **2025** to recognize her exceptional contributions to **literature** and **creative expression**.
 
• The **Serena Memorial Child Prodigy Award** is a prestigious international recognition specifically designed to identify and encourage children who exhibit **extraordinary skills** and **intellectual depth** in the field of arts and letters.
 
• The **Panorama International Literature Festival** is one of the world's largest literary programs, aiming to unite **authors**, **poets**, and **artists** from across the globe under a single platform to promote **humanitarian values**.
 
• **Nairithi Konduru**'s achievement reflects the rising influence of young Indian writers on the **global literary stage**, showcasing creative maturity far beyond her **age**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Writers Capital International Foundation:**

 
 
• The foundation is a **non-profit organization** that works toward fostering **global peace**, **unity**, and **cultural exchange** through **literature** and **education**.
 
• It organizes the **Panorama International Literature Festival** annually, which sees participation from over **100 countries** and features various categories of awards for **literary excellence**.
 
 
 
• **The Serena Memorial Award:**
 
 
• This specific award is named in memory of **Serena**, a child prodigy whose life and talents inspired the creation of a platform to support **gifted children**.
 
• It aims to provide **global visibility** to children like **Nairithi Konduru**, helping them refine their **creative crafts** and connect with **international mentors**.
 
 
 
• **Panorama International Literature Festival (PILF) 2025:**
 
 
• The **2025 edition** of the festival focused on themes related to **sustainability**, **peace**, and the **digital future of literature**.
 
• Apart from the child prodigy category, the festival also honors seasoned writers; for instance, **Vinita Agrawal** is a noted **Indian poet** and editor who has been associated with such international literary forums.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Young Authors:**
 
 
• Such awards serve as a significant **milestone** for young authors, often leading to opportunities for **international publishing** and **literary fellowships**.
 
• **Karnav Rastogi** and **Salman Lakda** are also names frequently associated with **youth achievement** and **literature** in various regional and national contexts, highlighting a vibrant culture of **child authors** in **India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Selection Process:** The winners are selected by an **international jury** based on the **originality**, **depth**, and **impact** of their written works or artistic contributions.
 
• **Global Recognition:** Receiving an award at **PILF** places the recipient among a community of **global thinkers** and **literary icons**, providing a foundation for a professional career in **humanities**.
 
• **Year 2025:** This year marked a significant increase in **technological integration** within the festival, allowing for **hybrid participation** from young prodigies across different **continents**.
